chunks.text:
[Intro]
{entering a sunlit reliquary: a cascade of glassy bells rising like light striking a mirror, a pad bloom and a short drum roll into the theme}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
pulse-wave lead doubled an octave higher by bright glassy bells
sparkling ascending bell arpeggios like sunlight caught in mirrors
harp arpeggios over a warm sustained pad
light sampled snare and tambourine with a glassy bell on each accent
